description: List the comments stakeholders and users have left on a project through the feedback widget, newest first. Each one is pinned to a page position (often to a named element) and carries device info; filter by status "new" when triaging. Use summarise_feedback to turn a list of these into themes and an implementation brief, and get_feedback for one comment's replies and screenshot.

limit.description: Maximum comments to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 50; total_matching reports how many matched.

page_path.description: Only comments left on this exact page path (no host or query string), e.g. "/checkout". Omit for every page.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"; only comments left at or after it. Omit for no lower bound.

status.description: Only comments in this status: new (nobody has looked yet), reviewed (assessed, still open), resolved (confirmed fixed) or dismissed (will not act on it). Omit for every status.

name: list_feedback

anchor_label.description: The page element the comment is pinned to, e.g. `button "Add to cart"`, when snapped to one.

device_info.description: Browser, viewport and device details recorded by the widget, or null.

has_screenshot.description: True when get_feedback can return a screenshot URL.

id.description: Comment UUID, the feedback_id for get_feedback and update_feedback_status.

page_title.description: The page's own document title, when recorded.

page_url.description: Full URL of the page the comment was left on.

status.description: new (nobody has looked yet), reviewed (assessed, still open), resolved (confirmed fixed) or dismissed (will not act on it).

version.description: Page version label (v1, v2, ...) numbered from the earliest version anyone commented on.

total_matching.description: How many comments matched the filters, before the limit.

title: List comments
